name: North Cape Current — Northern branch
scope: Declared western Hopen Deep Northern-branch study-area reach, from an OSW southern Hopen approach gate near 30 E, 75 N to the LS05 frontal/core neighborhood near 28.5 E, 77 N. Excludes Barents Sea entrance, Central branch, eastern continuations and cyclonic recirculation loops. Not the full North Cape Current or an observed trajectory.
layer: Northern-branch Atlantic-water jet context. Fig. 9 LS05 vectors average 20–80 m; no uniform fixed-depth axis is established along this editorial reach. The separate 15-crossing fitted-width composite retains unresolved depth support.
time_convention: Editorial geographic reach informed by Morozov et al. (2017) study in 2007, with general branch geography from IMR/PINRO (2009). Not a dated observed axis, annual mean or seasonal route.
source_locator: Stationary currents p. 38: Northern branch enters Hopen Deep and partially recirculates; Currents pp. 46–47, Fig. 1 and Fig. 9: western Hopen margin study area and LS05 current/front core near the 200 m isobath. Figures inspected for regional orientation, not digitized.
source_citation: Morozov, Pavlov, Pavlova and Fedorov (2017), Polar Frontal Zone of the Barents Sea Western Trough Based on the Direct Measurements in 2007, Physical Oceanography 2, 36–50, doi:10.22449/1573-160X-2017-2-36-50.
source_license: Copyright 2017 authors and Physical Oceanography. Attributed regional facts paraphrased; no source figures, curves, velocity data or coastlines packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects the southern study-area approach, intermediate western-margin waypoints and rounded LS05 frontal neighborhood. These are declared editorial gates, not source-provided paired current endpoints. Source figures establish study orientation, not a digitized current line. The section ship track is transverse and is not used as the longitudinal route. Alternative bends and endpoint offsets test coarse choices only.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Alternative OSW study-area approach/bend; not observed seasonal migration.
Alternative OSW study-area approach/bend; no physical meander or recirculation loop reconstructed.

scenario_rule: Three editorial study-area shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.1/0/+0.1 degrees: 81 sensitivity cases. Not fit uncertainty, current width or annual variability.
remaining_gates: Validate editorial approach and LS05 core-neighborhood gates with source authors and finer bathymetry.
Resolve full Northern/Central branching paths and recirculation before whole-system dimensions.
Acquire dated velocity geometry before physical axis or meander length.
Keep 8 km Gaussian profile scale separate; no buffering, annual dimensions or footprint inference.

supporting_sources.citation: Anon. (2009), Survey report from the joint Norwegian/Russian ecosystem survey in the Barents Sea August–October 2008, volume 1, IMR/PINRO Joint Report Series No. 1/2009.
supporting_sources.locator: Hydrographical conditions, pp. 20–21: Central branch south of Central Bank; Northern branch above 74°30 N on Vardo-North section, toward Hopen Trench.
supporting_sources.role: Independent branch distinction and broad geography; no section-width or date transfer to candidate.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
